topics.name: Upgrade Point of No Return
topics.purpose: Define explicit stage after which simple rollback is invalid because of irreversible migrations/data/protocol changes.

semantics.identity_rule: Point-of-no-return marker/stage is explicit within upgrade plan.
semantics.pre_rule: Required backup/verification/approval may be mandatory before crossing.
semantics.rollback_rule: After crossing, recovery uses forward-fix/restore/failover semantics rather than naive rollback.
semantics.ui_rule: Operator confirmation may supplement but never replace exact gates.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

references.purpose: Point-of-no-return belongs to exact upgrade plan.
